theorems.name: Submission.critSlices_image_volume_le_of_fderiv_near
theorems.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (G : Rn n → Rn m) (S : Set (Rn n)) (P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn m) (u₀ : Rn n) (d ε Λ : ℝ), Convex ℝ S → u₀ ∈ S → (∀ v ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ G v) → (∀ v ∈ S, ‖fderiv ℝ G v - P‖ ≤ ε) → (∀ v ∈ S, ‖v - u₀‖ ≤ d) → ¬ Function.Surjective P → ‖P‖ ≤ Λ → volume (G '' S) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (ε * d) * (2 * ((Λ + ε) * d)) ^ (m - 1))
